summary: Enhance your skills with our IoT and Sensor Networks Training Course. Learn the latest technologies and applications in the rapidly evolving IoT landscape.
lede: IoT security design and testing involves assessing exposure across devices, gateways, networks, and platforms. This course is for practitioners, managers, analysts, and decision-makers who need to plan dependable connected-device operations. You’ll map device-to-cloud flows, identify threats and lifecycle controls, and plan interoperability, resilience, and security tests through simulated workflows rather than production deployment.
audienceIntro: IoT and sensor networks professionals use this foundation-to-intermediate programme to connect physical measurements with reliable operational workflows. It is suitable for technical practitioners, managers, analysts, and adjacent decision-makers who need to scope, evaluate, secure, or coordinate connected-device initiatives.
prerequisites: You need a laptop with a modern web browser and permission to access course-provided simulation environments. The course uses representative datasets and configuration exercises, so you do not need access to live organizational devices. No programming background is required. Advanced concepts such as AI-assisted anomaly detection, cloud IoT services, and industrial cybersecurity receive conceptual or operational treatment rather than production engineering treatment.
